source_text: Non est Deus ut homo ut mentiatur, nec ut filius hominis ut mutetur. Dixit et faciet.
pass_a_gloss: Not is God as man that he-should-lie, nor as son of-man that he-should-be-changed. He-spoke and he-will-do.
pass_b_english: [[God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should change >> Bible:Numbers 23:19]]. He has spoken, and he will do.
